faqs.question: Which is better, 99acres or MagicBricks?
faqs.answer: Neither is better everywhere. Both are free for buyers, offer free basic owner listings and sell similar paid packages to brokers and builders. Which brings more genuine enquiries depends on your city, locality and budget, so test the smallest package on one for a month and compare cost per site visit.

faqs.question: Does 99acres charge money?
faqs.answer: Buyers and tenants use 99acres free, and owners can post a basic listing free with limits. Brokers, dealers and builders pay for packages that add more listings and better placement. Package prices vary by city, number of listings and duration, so ask for a written quote including GST.

faqs.question: Is MagicBricks free for owners?
faqs.answer: Yes, owners can post a basic listing on MagicBricks free. Paid plans add visibility and extra services. In busy localities free listings usually appear below featured and premium ones, so they may get fewer views than paid listings.

faqs.question: Who owns 99acres and MagicBricks?
faqs.answer: 99acres is owned by Info Edge, the listed company behind Naukri.com. MagicBricks is part of the Times Group through Times Internet. Both are long-running Indian property portals covering resale, rent, new projects and commercial property, and both earn mainly from paid packages sold to brokers, builders and owners.

faqs.question: Are 99acres and MagicBricks reliable for buying a home?
faqs.answer: Both are established platforms, but individual listings need checking. Use verified filters, confirm any new project's RERA number on the state RERA website, visit before paying a token, be wary of prices far below the locality and pay only to the owner's or developer's account.

faqs.question: Why do the same listings show different prices on different portals?
faqs.answer: Because several brokers often list the same property, each with their own asking price, and some listings are stale. No portal price is final. Compare similar flats in the same society, check recent registered sale values where available and negotiate from there.

faqs.question: How do 99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com and NoBroker compare?
faqs.answer: 99acres, MagicBricks and Housing.com work similarly: free for buyers, paid packages for brokers and builders. NoBroker is built around owner-to-buyer and owner-to-tenant deals without brokers and earns from paid plans for buyers, tenants and owners. Choose by which one your buyers use locally.

faqs.question: Why do portal leads not convert?
faqs.answer: The same buyer usually enquires on several similar listings, so many advertisers call them. Sellers who reply within minutes on WhatsApp, ask two qualifying questions and offer two specific site-visit slots tend to win the visit over those who call back the next day.

faqs.question: Should a builder use portals or their own ads?
faqs.answer: Most builders use both: a portal project page for presence among active searchers, and most of the budget on their own landing page, Meta and Google ads and an instant WhatsApp reply, because those leads come to the builder alone instead of being shared with other advertisers.
